commands:
set -euo pipefail; REPO='MichalMatu/tracker'; EXPECTED='eb10cdd70039e82d09cc03231b52ad851fe42546'; VERSION='v1.0.0-phase3-pre-field.1'; CHECKPOINT='checkpoint-phase3-pre-field-golden-2026-09-09'; APK_NAME="BlueEye-Tracker-${VERSION}-debug.apk"; SHA_NAME="${APK_NAME}.sha256"; git fetch --no-tags origin main; test "$(git rev-parse origin/main)" = "$EXPECTED"; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED"; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; RELEASE_TARGET=$(gh api "repos/${REPO}/releases/tags/${VERSION}" --jq '.target_commitish'); test "${RELEASE_TARGET}" = "${EXPECTED}"; TMP=$(mktemp -d); trap 'rm -rf "${TMP}"' EXIT; gh release download "${VERSION}" --repo "${REPO}" --dir "${TMP}" --pattern "${APK_NAME}" --pattern "${SHA_NAME}"; test -f "${TMP}/${APK_NAME}"; test -f "${TMP}/${SHA_NAME}"; EXPECTED_HASH=$(awk 'NR==1 {print $1}' "${TMP}/${SHA_NAME}"); test "$(printf '%s' "${EXPECTED_HASH}" | wc -c | tr -d ' ')" = '64'; ACTUAL_HASH=$(shasum -a 256 "${TMP}/${APK_NAME}" | awk '{print $1}'); test "${ACTUAL_HASH}" = "${EXPECTED_HASH}"; API_DIGEST=$(gh api "repos/${REPO}/releases/tags/${VERSION}" --jq '.assets[] | select(.name == "'"${APK_NAME}"'") | .digest'); test "${API_DIGEST}" = "sha256:${ACTUAL_HASH}"; test -z "$(git ls-remote --tags origin "refs/tags/${CHECKPOINT}" "refs/tags/${CHECKPOINT}^{}")"; if git show-ref --verify --quiet "refs/tags/${CHECKPOINT}"; then echo "local checkpoint tag unexpectedly exists: ${CHECKPOINT}" >&2; exit 3; fi; git tag -a "${CHECKPOINT}" "${EXPECTED}" -m 'Phase 3 pre-field golden checkpoint'; OBJ=$(git rev-parse "${CHECKPOINT}"); PEELED=$(git rev-parse "${CHECKPOINT}^{}"); TYPE=$(git cat-file -t "${CHECKPOINT}"); test "${PEELED}" = "${EXPECTED}"; test "${TYPE}" = 'tag'; git push origin "refs/tags/${CHECKPOINT}"; REMOTE=$(git ls-remote --tags origin "refs/tags/${CHECKPOINT}^{}" | awk '{print $1}'); test "${REMOTE}" = "${EXPECTED}"; printf 'version=%s
apk=%s
apk_sha256=%s
checkpoint=%s
checkpoint_object=%s
checkpoint_peeled=%s
checkpoint_type=%s
' "${VERSION}" "${APK_NAME}" "${ACTUAL_HASH}" "${CHECKPOINT}" "${OBJ}" "${PEELED}" "${TYPE}"; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
